props.text:
## This round, in one line
The app got tighter around its wedge — **a reactive explainer you share as one offline HTML file** — and friendlier to **LLM-authored notebooks**. Everything below was verified live and is covered by tests.

## What changed this round

| Area | Change | Why |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Share | Shared files open in a locked **Reader** + Remix | recipient needs no app |
| Export | Ships only the notebook, not your catalog | no inventory leak |
| Value box | Hugs its value, shows in Edit | no clipped digits, no surprises |
| Fuse | Slot-header toggle + draggable seam | control where the join is |
| Store | Dropped raw Slider / Number / Formula / Chart | finished cards over primitives |
| Authoring | New-notebook **JSON / AI** front door | LLM-authored notebooks |
| First run | Lands in Study on a live example | the reactive *aha* first |

## Still one self-contained card
Drag `n` — the square and the chart react. Variables are **card-scoped**, so this card is complete on its own and travels in a single file.

## Try the wedge
Hit **Share** — this becomes one HTML file that opens anywhere as a clean **Reader**. In a shared file, click **Remix** to edit your own copy.
